```{r R Settings, include = FALSE} 
##### Predefined Functions
  
  Basic_Table = function(df_input, column_align, row_green = FALSE, row_red = FALSE, row_mirae_3 = FALSE){
    
    table_ouput = df_input %>%
      
      kable(align = column_align, row.names = FALSE) %>%
      
      kable_styling(position = 'center') %>%
      
      row_spec(0, color = w, background = mirae_01)
    
      if (row_green[1]) {
        
      table_ouput = table_ouput %>% row_spec(row_green, color = g)
      
      }
  
      if (row_red[1]) {
        
      table_ouput = table_ouput %>% row_spec(row_red, color = r)
      
      }
  
      if (row_mirae_3[1]) {
      
      table_ouput = table_ouput %>% row_spec(row_mirae_3, color = mirae_03)
      
      }
    
    return(table_ouput)
    
  }
  
  SectorWise_RTD = function(df_input){
    
    df_2_plot = df_input %>% select(Sector, RTD) %>%
      
      mutate(bar_color = ifelse(RTD > df_input$RTD[1], 'Positive_Bar', 'Negative_Bar')) %>%
      
      mutate(text_color = ifelse(RTD > df_input$RTD[1], 'Positive_Text', 'Negative_Text')) 
  
    df_2_plot$bar_color[1] = 'Market_Bar'
    
    df_2_plot$text_color[1] = 'Market_Text' 
    
    df_2_plot = df_2_plot[order(df_2_plot$RTD, decreasing = TRUE),] %>%
      
      mutate(Sector = factor(Sector, levels = Sector))
    
    p = ggplot(data = df_2_plot, aes(x = Sector, y = RTD)) +
      
        geom_bar(stat = 'identity', aes(fill = bar_color)) +
      
        coord_flip() +
        
        geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(RTD * 100, 2), '%'), color = text_color), size = 2.2) +
        
        labs(x = '', y = '', title = 'Sector Wise RTD') +
        
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
        
        scale_fill_manual(values = fills) +
        
        scale_colour_manual(values = colours) + 
        
        theme_bw()
      
    return(p)
    
  }
  
  SectorWise_Contribution = function(df_input){
    
    df_2_plot = data.frame(Sector = df_input$`Sector`[2:nrow(df_input)],
                           Contribution = df_input$`Contribution`[2:nrow(df_input)])
    
    df_2_plot = df_2_plot[order(df_2_plot$Contribution, decreasing = TRUE),] %>%
      
      mutate(id = seq_along(Contribution)) %>%
      
      mutate(bar_color = ifelse(Contribution > 0, 'Positive_Bar', 'Negative_Bar')) %>%
      
      mutate(text_color = ifelse(Contribution > 0, 'Positive_Text', 'Negative_Text')) %>%
      
      mutate(end = cumsum(Contribution)) %>%
      
      mutate(start = c(0, head(end, -1))) %>%
      
      mutate(Sector = factor(Sector, levels = Sector))
    
    p = ggplot(data = df_2_plot, aes(Sector)) +
      
        geom_rect(aes(x = Sector, xmin = id - 0.45, xmax = id + 0.45, ymin = end, ymax = start, fill = bar_color)) +
        
        coord_flip() +
        
        geom_text(aes(x = Sector, y = (start + end)/2, 
                      label = paste0(round(df_2_plot$Contribution * 10000, 1), 'bp'),
                      color = text_color), size = 2.2) +
        
        labs(x = '', y = '', title = 'Sector Wise Contribution') +
        
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
        
        scale_fill_manual(values = fills) +
        
        scale_colour_manual(values = colours) + 
        
        theme_bw()
      
    return(p)
  
  }
  
  Yield_Curve_Change = function(df_input){
    
    df_input = df_input %>% 
      
      select(UST_Categories, YTD_Base, YTD_Current) %>%
      
      mutate(YTD_Base = YTD_Base / 100) %>%
      
      mutate(YTD_Current = YTD_Current / 100) %>%
      
      mutate(UST_Categories = factor(UST_Categories, levels = UST_Categories))
  
    p = ggplot(data = df_input, aes(x = UST_Categories, group = 1)) +
      
        geom_line(aes(y = YTD_Current, colour = 'YTD_Current'), linetype = 2) +
      
        geom_line(aes(y = YTD_Base, colour = 'YTD_Base'), linetype = 2) + 
      
        geom_point(aes(y = YTD_Current, colour = 'YTD_Current')) +
      
        geom_point(aes(y = YTD_Base, colour = 'YTD_Base')) + 
    
        geom_text(aes(y = 0.042, label = paste0(round((YTD_Current - YTD_Base) * 10000, 1), 'bp'), color = 'YTD_Current'), size = 3) +
      
        labs(x = '', y = '', title = 'UST Yield Curve 1D Change') +
      
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      
        scale_colour_manual(values = colours) + 
      
        theme_bw() +
      
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
              panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
              panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
              panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
              legend.position = 'None')
    
    return(p)  
  
  }
  
  json_to_dataframe <- function(db_connection, table_name, date, index_name) {
  
    # Define the SQL query
    query <- paste0("SELECT data FROM ", table_name, " WHERE date = ? AND index_name = ?")
  
    # Prepare and execute the SQL statement
    stmt <- dbSendQuery(db_connection, query)
    dbBind(stmt, list(date, index_name))
  
    # Fetch the result
    result <- dbFetch(stmt)
  
    # Clear the statement
    dbClearResult(stmt)
  
    # Parse the JSON data into a data frame
    parsed <- fromJSON(result$data[1], flatten = TRUE)
  
    # Replace NULL with NA
    parsed_clean <- lapply(parsed, function(col) {
      lapply(col, function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA else x)
    })
  
    # Unlist all columns
    parsed_unlisted <- lapply(parsed_clean, unlist)
  
    # Create data frame
    df <- as.data.frame(parsed_unlisted, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
    # Drop rows with any NA
    df <- tidyr::drop_na(df)
  
    return(df)
  
  }
  
  df_sectorwise = function(db_connection, base_date, current_date, index_name){

    df_base_date = json_to_dataframe(db_connection, 'LookThroughIndustryGroup', base_date, index_name) %>%
      select(-FactSet_Symbol) %>%
      rename(Last_Price_Base_Date = Last_Price)
    
    df_current_date = json_to_dataframe(db_connection, 'LookThroughIndustryGroup', current_date, index_name) %>%
      select(-c(Weight, FactSet_Symbol)) %>%
      rename(Last_Price_Current_Date = Last_Price)
    
    df = df_base_date %>% left_join(df_current_date, by = c('Sector')) %>%
      mutate(RTD = Last_Price_Current_Date / Last_Price_Base_Date - 1) %>%
      mutate(`Weight*RTD` = Weight * RTD) %>%
      mutate(`Weight*RTD` = ifelse(row_number() == 1, sum(`Weight*RTD`[-1]), `Weight*RTD`)) %>%
      mutate(Contribution = `Weight*RTD` * first(RTD) / first(`Weight*RTD`)) %>%
      select(-c(Last_Price_Base_Date, Last_Price_Current_Date, `Weight*RTD`))
    
    return(df)
  
  }
  
  df_constituents_to_sectorwise <- function(db_connection, base_date, current_date, index_name, Sectors) {
  
    # Fetch data for base_date and current_date
    df_base <- json_to_dataframe(db_connection, "All_Constituents", base_date, index_name) %>%
      rename(Last_Price_Base = Last_Price)
    
    df_current <- json_to_dataframe(db_connection, "All_Constituents", current_date, index_name) %>%
      select(-Constituent_Weight) %>%
      rename(Last_Price_Current = Last_Price)
    
    # Merge the two data frames
    df <- left_join(df_base, df_current, by = c("FactSet_Symbol", "Company_Name", "Sector", "Industry_Group", "Industry")) %>%
      mutate(
        RTD = Last_Price_Current / Last_Price_Base - 1,
        Contribution = Constituent_Weight * RTD
      ) %>%
      select(-Last_Price_Base, -Last_Price_Current)
    
    # Create a grouped dataframe for sectors
    df_grouped <- data.frame(Sector = Sectors)
    
    df_grouped <- df_grouped %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        Weight = if (Sector %in% c("Media & Entertainment", "Telecommunication Services")) {
          sum(df$Constituent_Weight[df$Industry_Group == Sector], na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          sum(df$Constituent_Weight[df$Sector == Sector], na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        Contribution = if (Sector %in% c("Media & Entertainment", "Telecommunication Services")) {
          sum(df$Contribution[df$Industry_Group == Sector], na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          sum(df$Contribution[df$Sector == Sector], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(RTD = Contribution / Weight)
    
    # Add a "Market" row summarizing the data
    new_row <- data.frame(
      Sector = "Market",
      Weight = sum(df$Constituent_Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      Contribution = sum(df$Contribution, na.rm = TRUE),
      RTD = sum(df$Contribution, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(df$Constituent_Weight, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    # Combine the grouped data with the new row
    df_result <- bind_rows(new_row, df_grouped)
    
    return(df_result)
  }

```

* 지수 내 개별 종목, 섹터(GICS Lev 1), 산업군(GICS Lev2) 비중은 전일 종가 & USD 기준

* S&P500 (PR, USD) / MSCI UK (PR, GBP) / MSCI EMU (PR, EUR) / MSCI Japan (PR, JPY) / MSCI EM (PR, USD)

* FactSet 기준 MSCI 지수의 업데이트가 지연되는 경우, 개별 종목 비중(전일 종가 USD) & 개별 종목 수익률(PR, Local)을 사용해서 지수 수익률을 계산

## 일본(MSCI Japan) GICS 섹터별 기여도
***

```{r JP Sector Wise Contribution}

df = df_sectorwise(con, base_date, current_date, 'MSCI Japan')

#df = df_constituents_to_sectorwise(con, base_date, current_date, 'MSCI Japan', Sectors)

df_input = df[order(df$RTD, decreasing = TRUE),] %>%
  
  mutate(Weight = paste0(round(Weight * 100, 2), ' %')) %>%
  
  mutate(RTD = paste0(round(RTD * 100, 2), ' %')) %>%
  
  mutate(Contribution = paste0(round(Contribution * 100, 2), ' %'))

Basic_Table(df_input = df_input, column_align = rep('c', ncol(df_input))) %>%
  
  row_spec(which(df_input$Sector == 'Market'), background = mirae_02, color = w)

rm(df_input)

ggarrange(SectorWise_RTD(df) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
                                     panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
                                     panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
                                     panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
                                     panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
                                     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
                                     axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = -20), color = mirae_02, face = 'bold'),
                                     axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                                     legend.position = 'none'),
          SectorWise_Contribution(df) + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
                                              panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
                                              panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
                                              panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
                                              panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
                                              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
                                              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(t = -20), color = mirae_02, face = 'bold'),
                                              axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                                              legend.position = 'none',), nrow = 1, ncol = 2)

```
